text: Nvidia gains 31.48% amid Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO. The Nasdaq rises 6.51%, the semiconductor ETF 13.63%, and major AI infrastructure stocks 16-24%. Anthropic declines 1.43%. Trump reports direct intervention with Nvidia's board.

meta.note: Executive reinstatement and market repricing coexist; their causal relationship remains unassigned.

text: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO with senior U.S. government input and presidential support. Colette Kress retains her CFO position. The independent investigation remains active, alongside congressional scrutiny of export-control compliance.

meta.note: Executive reinstatement does not establish investigative resolution or formal exoneration.

text: Trump confirms direct involvement in Nvidia's unanimous reinstatement of Jensen Huang. The board requested national security guarantees and received administration assurances. Federal investigation of Megaspeed and independent corporate oversight remain active.

meta.note: Distinct from the reinstatement itself; this entry isolates the government-corporate authority interface.
